title: MMR International Study Trip
description: MMR study trip sponsored by Desautels Faculty of Management.
notes: As part of the experiential module of the MMR program, students will have the opportunity to participate in an international study trip and spend one-week in a retail-centric city visiting retail companies and meeting practitioners to learn about working at each specific firm and the retail space. A fee of 2,500$ is to be associated with any student who will participate in the trip, the fee will cover part (~50%) of flight, hotel, meals, events, and transportation
